Job Description: 
 Analyst Software Engineering 
 Remote, US (Connecticut based preferred) 

 About DXC 
 DXC helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds. The world’s largest companies and public sector organizations trust DXC to deploy services to drive new levels of performance, competitiveness, and customer experience across their IT estates. Our more than 125,000 people in 70-plus countries are entrusted by our customers to deliver transformative technologies to ensure the success, safety and well-being of businesses and people around the world. By combining strengths and expertise globally, we create solutions and deliver greater outcomes for customers across their entire IT estate. Learn more about how we deliver excellence for our customers and colleagues at dxc.com. 
 
About the Team / Offering – Consulting & Engineering Services 
 Our global team of consulting, engineering, and technology experts partners with the world’s most innovative companies to help them thrive in an AI-powered world. With a strong foundation of values, deep industry expertise, and an extensive partner network, our people are trusted by clients to lead transformative change. 
 
About the Role 
 DXC Technology is seeking a Software Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that software solutions align with organizational goals and technical requirements. This role is ideal for candidates ranging from entry-level to senior analyst levels, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects while developing deep expertise in requirements analysis, system design, and quality assurance processes. 
 In this position, you will work closely with business leaders, users, developers, and quality assurance teams to gather requirements, document technical specifications, and ensure that systems are optimized for performance and security. You will play a key role in translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable information for non-technical stakeholders, while also ensuring that business needs are accurately communicated to development teams. 
 
This role supports an ITAR-compliant client account and requires strict adherence to specific security and work authorization requirements, reflecting the sensitive and mission-critical nature of the work performed. As such, candidates must be able to provide proof of US citizenship and meet specific security and work authorization requirements outlined below. 
 
Essential Job Functions 
 Gather and document clear project goals and technical specifications by meeting with business leaders and users 
 Analyze existing software architectures to identify performance issues, security gaps, and optimization opportunities 
 Create detailed functional designs, user stories, and Software Requirement Specification (SRS) documents 
 Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical teams and communicate business needs clearly to developers 
 Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to technical standards 
 Coordinate defect tracking with quality assurance teams 
 Troubleshoot and resolve production issues 
 Serve as a cross-functional liaison between business and technical teams 
 
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field 
 Experience with programming and query languages such as SQL, Python, Java, or C#, plus database management 
 Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and verbal or written communication skills 
 Typically 0–2 years of relevant experience in software development, project coordination, or agile environment; senior analyst roles may require 3 to 5+ years of technical or software development background 
 
Other Qualifications 
 Must be ITAR-compliant and able to provide proof of citizenship 
 Must be a legal US Citizen on US Soil; Puerto Rico is not exempt for this account 
 Applicants must reside in the continental United States 
 Must pass a background check and drug test 
 


 Why DXC? / Life at DXC 
 DXC is an employer of choice with strong values, and fosters a culture of inclusion, belonging and corporate citizenship. We inspire and take care of our people. We work to create a culture of learning, diversity and inclusion and are dedicated to strong ethics and corporate citizenship. DXC is where brilliant people seize opportunities to advance their careers and amplify customer success. Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program. DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off. 
 
 
Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $50,500 - $93,800. 
 Full-time hires are eligible to participate in the DXC benefit program.  DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.
 
 At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available   here .
